factor_diagnostics.value_notes: NOAA's 2026 Pacific groundfish synthesis reports all life stages in kelp forests to 172 m; the NOAA AFSC guide reports common depth of 0-16 fathoms (0-30 m) and a maximum around 146 m. This supports broad depth use but shows the configured 5-80 m band is not a complete species depth envelope and the 7-75 m ideal is not a measured preference.
